children: is expected to retrace into a range of $83.45 to $84.35 per barrel, following its failure to break a resistance at $88.61.
The failure suggests a completion of the bounce from $83.88, or the first part of the bounce. Considering the weakness of the bounce, the market may retrace toward the $83.45 to $84.35 range first.
It is not very clear if the bounce would extend. An extension would be suggested by a stabilization of the market around $84.35.
A break below $83.45 could open the way toward $78.18. On the hourly chart, the market is expected to test a support at $85.18.
A break could trigger a fall into the range of $82.85 to $84.02, formed by the 161.8% and the 150% projection levels of a downtrend from $98.85.
